name: ali_cbct
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Anatomic Landmarks Identification on CBCT scans using AI. Detects anatomical reference points automatically. NOTE: If the user wants to orient the scan using landmarks they placed manually, use 'semi_aso_cbct' instead.

name: ali_ios
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Landmark Identification in Intraoral Scans (IOS). Detects dental and anatomical landmarks automatically on 3D surface meshes. NOTE: For manual landmark orientation, use 'semi_aso_ios'.

name: amasss_cli
description: AMASSS - Single-scan Anatomical Structures Segmentation from CBCT. Focuses on large skull structures: cranial base, maxilla, mandible, airway, and condyles. NOTE: Do NOT use this for batch processing (use 'batchdentalseg') or for impacted canines (use 'clic').

name: areg_cbct
description: Automatic Registration of CBCT-to-CBCT images. Registers baseline and follow-up CBCT scans using deformable or rigid registration. NOTE: Use this exclusively for matching two CBCT scans together, NOT for MRI-to-CBCT.

name: areg_ios
description: Automatic Registration of Intraoral Scans (IOS-to-IOS) using ICP. Registers baseline and follow-up IOS surfaces (dental models/impressions) together.

name: autocrop3d
description: Automatic 3D region cropping. Extracts and crops specific areas of interest from all cases in a study using a saved ROI .json file marker from Volume Rendering. NOTE: For specifically cropping the TMJ, use 'mri2cbct_tmj_crop'.

name: automatrix
description: Apply geometric transformation matrices (shift, rotate, mirror, affine) to medical images and 3D surface meshes. NOTE: Use this when the user explicitly asks to apply a matrix (.tfm) or transform coordinates.

name: batchdentalseg
description: BATCH processing for Dental Segmentation. Automated segmentation of dental structures from MULTIPLE scans. Specifically includes models for PEDIATRIC/children (mixed dentition) and UNIVERSAL NUMBERING SYSTEM labeling. NOTE: Use this ONLY when explicitly asked for batch, multiple scans, pediatric, or universal numbering.

name: clic
description: CLIC - Instance Segmentation and Localization of IMPACTED CANINES from CBCT using Mask-RCNN. Identifies the exact position (buccal, palatal, bicortical) of impacted teeth. Use this tool anytime the user asks to split/isolate individual teeth or analyze impacted canines.

name: docshapeaxi
description: DOC-ShapeAXI - Statistical shape analysis and geometry classification. Specifically designed to classify nasopharynx airways obstruction, mandibular condyles severity, and alveolar bone defect in clefts.

name: flexreg
description: Flexible Patch-based Registration for dental surfaces. Registers 3D dental meshes using precise deformable patches (butterfly/curve) for tooth movement tracking.

name: medical_data_anonymizer
description: Automatically anonymize sensitive information (PII/PHI) in medical documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, XML) to ensure HIPAA compliance and patient privacy.

name: medx_dashboard
description: MedX Dashboard - Visualizes data and creates interactive HTML dashboards from structured comorbidity summaries. Use this when the user asks to 'visualize', 'make a picture of data', or 'create a dashboard'.

name: medx_summarize
description: MedX Summarize - Extracts TMJ-related comorbidities from unstructured clinical notes (PDF, DOCX) using fine-tuned NLP models to generate concise summaries.

name: mri2cbct_approx
description: MRI to CBCT approximation. Converts and preprocesses MRI spaces to CBCT format for multimodal registration. NOTE: Use this for approximation/conversion before the final registration.

name: mri2cbct_reg
description: MRI-to-CBCT Image Registration. Overlays, synchronizes, and registers an MRI volume onto a CBCT reference frame using intensity normalization.

name: mri2cbct_lr_crop
description: Crop volumes for left-right asymmetry analysis. Extracts left and right hemimandibular/hemimaxillary regions to see bilateral differences between the two sides.

name: mri2cbct_orient_center
description: Orient, center, and fix the position of MRI scans for standardized positioning. Reorients MRI volumes to a canonical anatomical frame.

name: mri2cbct_resample
description: Resample MRI and CBCT to uniform spacing. Harmonizes image sizes and makes them the same resolution/size for standardized processing.

name: mri2cbct_tmj_crop
description: Automatic Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) / jaw joint region cropping. Segments and extracts ONLY the TMJ or jaw bone area from scans.

name: pre_aso_cbct
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Preprocessing and orientation for CBCT. Standardizes orientation and field-of-view using ONLY the scan as input. NOTE: If the user mentions landmarks or manual points, use 'semi_aso_cbct' instead.

name: pre_aso_ios
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Preprocessing and orientation for IOS (Intraoral scans). Straightens and orients surface meshes using ONLY the scan as input. NOTE: If the user mentions manual landmarks, use 'semi_aso_ios' instead.

name: semi_aso_cbct
description: SEMI-AUTOMATIC Orientation for CBCT. Requires both the scan AND a manually-placed landmark/fiducial file as input. NOTE: Use this ONLY if the user explicitly mentions using, placing, or marking points/landmarks files.

name: semi_aso_ios
description: SEMI-AUTOMATIC Orientation for IOS. Requires both the dental surface mesh AND a manually-placed landmark/fiducial file as input. NOTE: Use this ONLY if the user explicitly mentions using or marking points/landmarks files.
